user.title: Connect to arbox-server
user.description: Point Home Assistant at your arbox-server container. The API key is in the server's settings.json (needed for booking actions).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure arbox-server
reconfigure.description: Change the server URL or paste a new API key. Your entities, areas and automations are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach arbox-server at this URL.
error.server_not_configured: The server is up but has no Arbox credentials yet — open its web UI and connect first.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by arbox-server — copy it from the server's settings.json.

abort.wrong_server: That URL is a different arbox-server. To use it, add it as a new integration instead.

init.title: Arbox panel access
init.description: Administrators always have full access. Action access includes viewing. These permissions apply to the Arbox panel, not existing HA entities or services. Feedback notification links retain their limited access.

data.panel_action_users: Users allowed to book and edit
